node.statement: The scale window gives s >= tau/2 > 0, hence q != p_v. For every full row-point fiber Q define d_Q := sum_{j in Q}(q_j-P_vj). Applying the registered external lem-hx-transverse-moment-identity with q0=p_v, q1=q, and the given affine chi gives the exact unit moment sum_Q d_Q*chi(p_Q) = 1.
